title: SDG 6 潔淨水與衛生
footer: Teacher Dom · SDG #6 Clean Water and Sanitation 潔淨水與衛生

strip.en: years of rain for Grandfather Banyan
strip.zh: 年的雨水，養大了榕樹爺爺

strip.en: Earth — and one supply of water

lines.en: In California, sometimes it does not rain for months.
lines.zh: 在加州，有時候好幾個月都不下雨。

lines.en: So we learn to take care of our water.
lines.zh: 所以我們學會好好照顧水。

slides.ask_en: Wave your hand and say: “Hello, Dom!”
Both places need the same thing every single day. Can you guess what it is?
slides.ask_zh: 這兩個地方每天都需要同一樣東西。猜猜看是什麼？

prompts.en: Stand up if you drank water this morning.
prompts.zh: 今天早上有喝水的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stay standing if you washed your hands today.
prompts.zh: 今天有洗手的，繼續站著。

prompts.en: Stay standing if you like your swimming lessons.
prompts.zh: 喜歡游泳課的，繼續站著。

slides.punch_en: Drinking, washing, swimming — we use water all day long.
slides.punch_zh: 喝水、洗手、游泳——我們一整天都在用水。

slides.q_en: Most of the water on Earth is…
slides.explain_en: 97 of every 100 drops are salty! Only a tiny bit is fresh water we can drink.
slides.explain_zh: 100 滴水裡有 97 滴是鹹的！只有一點點是我們能喝的淡水。

slides.head_zh: 每個生命都需要乾淨的水
slides.ask_en: Grandfather Banyan has been drinking the rain for 100 years. People, plants and animals all need clean water.
slides.ask_zh: 榕樹爺爺喝了一百年的雨水。人、植物、動物，都需要乾淨的水。

slides.head_en: In a class of 20 friends around the world…
slides.head_zh: 如果全世界是一個 20 個小朋友的班…
slides.reveal_en: 5 friends have no safe water to drink at home.
slides.reveal_zh: 有 5 個小朋友，家裡沒有安全的水可以喝。
slides.ask_zh: 我們先一起數數看有幾個人！

steps.en: WET your hands — then turn OFF the tap
steps.zh: 把手弄濕——然後關掉水龍頭

steps.en: SCRUB with soap and count to 20
RINSE, scoop water on the tap, and DRY
steps.zh: 沖乾淨、捧水沖龍頭、擦乾

slides.note_en: Thumbs up for SAVE, thumbs down for WASTE!

slides.head_en: liters saved every day — just turn off the tap when you brush
slides.head_zh: 刷牙時關水龍頭，每天可以省下 30 公升
slides.body_en: That is like 60 small bottles of water. Every single day!
slides.body_zh: 等於 60 小瓶的水，而且是每一天！
slides.ask_en: Can you brush with the tap off tonight?
slides.ask_zh: 今天晚上刷牙，你可以把水龍頭關掉嗎？

slides.q_en: Drip… drip… drip. A tap drips all day. How much water is lost?
slides.q_zh: 滴…答…滴…答。水龍頭滴了一整天，會流掉多少水？

options.zh: 大約 30 公升——三個水桶

slides.explain_en: About 30 liters a day! Close it tightly — and tell an adult if it still drips.
slides.explain_zh: 一天大約 30 公升！把它關緊——還在滴就告訴大人。

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.note_en: Clean streams help fish, plants and people.
items.note_zh: 乾淨的溪流養育魚、植物和人。

items.en: It is OK to throw trash in the river.
items.zh: 把垃圾丟進河裡沒關係。
items.note_en: Never! Trash belongs in the bin, not in the water.
items.note_zh: 不行！垃圾要丟垃圾桶，不能丟進水裡。

items.en: We can drink water from the ocean.
items.note_en: It is too salty. It makes you even thirstier.
items.note_zh: 海水太鹹了，喝了只會更渴。

items.en: Washing with soap keeps us healthy.
items.zh: 用肥皂洗手讓我們健康。

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, shout out as many things that need water as you can — in English. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文喊出越多「需要水的東西」越好，我來數！

slides.say_zh: 關水龍頭！每一滴水都很重要！

steps.en: Twist your hand — turn it off

slides.note_en: Watch — then show me how you turn off the tap.
slides.note_zh: 看完之後，做給我看：你怎麼關水龍頭？

items.en: Turn off the tap when I brush my teeth.
items.zh: 刷牙的時候關掉水龍頭。

items.en: Tell an adult when I see a drip.
items.zh: 看到水龍頭在滴水，就告訴大人。

items.en: Put trash in the bin — never in the river.
items.zh: 垃圾丟垃圾桶，絕對不丟進河裡。

slides.q_en: Who at Taiping studied for many years how to protect nature?
slides.q_zh: 太平國小裡，誰花了很多年研究怎麼保護大自然？
slides.explain_en: Principal Cheng is a doctor of environmental education. Ask him how to save water!
slides.explain_zh: 鄭校長是環境教育博士。去問問他怎麼省水！

slides.head_zh: 畫一張圖或寫一句話給 Dom
slides.body_en: Ask your teacher to open our School Tour page and find the Taiping Elementary column. Tell me how you will save water.
slides.body_zh: 請老師打開我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到太平國小那一欄，告訴我你要怎麼省水。

slides.big_en:
Every drop matters.
Turn off the tap!
slides.big_zh:
每一滴水都很重要。
關掉水龍頭！
